# Check 5, recomputed correctly: distinct uncommitted indices vs index range
tl = pd.DataFrame(cl.timeline)
distinct_uncommitted = sorted({e["index"] for r in cl.replicas for e in r.log
                               if e["index"] > cl.commit_index})
row = dict(
    distinct_uncommitted_indices = len(distinct_uncommitted),
    index_span_excess = tl.max_replica_log.max() - tl.canonical_log.max(),
    copies_across_replicas = sum(1 for r in cl.replicas for e in r.log
                                 if e["index"] > cl.commit_index))
row["check5_corrected_passes"] = row["distinct_uncommitted_indices"] == row["index_span_excess"]

pd.set_option("display.width", 160)
display(pd.DataFrame([row]))

# also show the honest liveness/durability split at that phase
tail = tl[tl.phase == "uncommitted-tail"].iloc[0]
display(pd.DataFrame([dict(
    phase="uncommitted-tail",
    replicas_up_liveness=int(tail.replicas_up),
    replicas_durably_holding_commit_index=int(tail.durable_at_commit),
    note="crash-stop replicas still hold durable state; liveness needs up>=Q, "
         "durability counts all holders")]))
